title: Warren — Maze Studio
description: Six maze algorithms carving live, four grid masks, braiding, distance heat maps, a play mode, and PNG/SVG export.
concept: Warren is a maze workbench. Pick one of six classic carving algorithms — recursive backtracker, Prim, Kruskal, Wilson, Eller, Sidewinder — and watch it cut the grid cell by cell, in a rectangle, circle, diamond or ring mask. Braid the result to open loops, flood it with a breadth-first heat map, pull out the longest path, then flip to Play mode and run it yourself with keys, swipes or the on-screen pad, with fog of war if you want it. Every maze is a seed, so the share link rebuilds it exactly; PNG at triple resolution and plottable SVG come out of the same renderer.
features: Six generators, each animated step by step with a carve-speed slider
Four grid masks (rect, circle, diamond, ring) with Eller/Sidewinder gated to the rectangle
Braid slider that removes dead ends to create loops
Analysis layer: distance heat map, shortest path, dead-end dots, animated BFS flood, longest-path diameter
Play mode with timer, step count, fog of war, swipe/keyboard/D-pad movement and per-size best times in localStorage
Click any cell in Design mode to move the start — the exit re-picks itself at the far end
PNG ×3 and vector SVG export, plus seed share links and a saved-seed shelf
Four themes (Blueprint, Nocturne, Papyrus, Neon) applied to both the canvas and the exports

interaction.mouse: Click a cell in Design mode to move the start; drag the sliders to resize, braid and set carve speed
interaction.click: Algorithm, mask and theme chips regenerate instantly; Generate animates, Instant skips to the finished maze
interaction.touch: Swipe on the maze to move in Play mode, or use the on-screen D-pad; all controls are thumb-sized
interaction.keyboard: Arrows/WASD move in Play mode · G regenerate · S solution · H heat map · P swap modes
